# SpaceX IPO: How to buy before June 12
Elon Musk's rocket and satellite company is [reportedly planning](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/spacex-seeks-135-share-75-015553054.html) to sell 555.6 million shares at $135 apiece, with the aim of raising $75 ​billion, making it the largest IPO in history, giving SpaceX a whopping $1.75 trillion valuation, if all goes as planned.

Shares purchased on secondary markets are typically subject to a lockup period after an IPO — usually 90 to 180 days — during which you cannot sell.

As of April 2026, Hiive listed SpaceX stock at around $832 per share.

Contrafund's [position in SpaceX](http://pdf.secdatabase.com/2426/0000024238-26-000023.pdf) is valued at around $3.5 billion, or just over 2% of the fund's $170 billion in assets.

With SpaceX reportedly filing for an IPO targeting a $1.5 trillion to an eye-popping $2 trillion valuation, the window for pre-public entry is narrowing.

web.description:
# 8 Things To Know Before SpaceX Goes Public
## Key Metrics
As of the date of this publication, SpaceX has not publicly confirmed an IPO valuation.

## What to Know Before SpaceX Goes Public
### SpaceX’s Estimated Valuation
At $1.75 trillion, SpaceX would price at roughly 94 times trailing 2025 revenue and about 73 times consensus 2026 estimates of $22 to $24 billion, extraordinary, but not an outlier within the launch-and-space cohort.

## Potential Valuations After The IPO
### Potential Valuations After SpaceX IPO
At a $1.75 cap it would carry roughly a 2% S&P 500 weight, implying $300 to $400 billion of mandatory passive demand against a tradeable float of perhaps $50 to $75 billion.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
SpaceX is expected to price on June 11, 2026, with first trading on the Nasdaq June 12 — after the public S-1 on May 20 and a confidential draft on April 1.

web.title: SpaceX IPO: Valuation, Timeline and Investment Options
web.description:
## SpaceX Goes Public: What Happened on June 12, 2026
In the largest [initial public offering (IPO)](https://smartasset.com/investing/what-is-an-ipo) in history, the company priced its shares at $135 each. This raised approximately $75 billion and SpaceX entered the public markets with a valuation approaching $1.8 trillion.

This quickly pushed the [company’s market value](https://smartasset.com/financial-advisor/market-value) above $2 trillion.

As of late June, SPCX was trading around $153, still above its $135 IPO price, but well below its post-IPO intraday high of $225.64.

## How SpaceX’s Valuation Compares
At roughly $1.8 trillion at its IPO pricing, and above $2 trillion after its initial trading surge, the company joined a small group of firms whose market capitalizations are measured in trillions rather than billions.

The company’s IPO capped a rapid rise in valuation driven by Starlink’s growth, expanding government contracts and strong investor demand.

| Event | Date | Valuation | Key Details |
|-|-|-|-|
| IPO pricing | June 11, 2026 | ~$1.75 trillion | 555.6 million shares priced at $135; largest IPO in history[16](https://smartasset.com/investing/spacex-ipo#citations) |
| Post-IPO trading | June 12–22, 2026 | $2.2 trillion (as of June 22) | Shares peaked at $225.64 on June 16 before pulling back. As of June 22, SPCX trades near $165, up approximately 22% from the $135 IPO price but down roughly 27% from its intraday high. |

## Investment Options for SPCX and What to Consider
SpaceX peaked at $225.64 within days of listing and has since pulled back sharply, even as the broader market moved higher.

# SpaceX
SpaceX completed its IPO on **June 12, 2026** and now trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker **SPCX**.

## SpaceX IPO: Inside the Largest Listing in History
The company priced its IPO at **$135 per share**, selling roughly 556.6 million shares to raise about **$75 billion** at a valuation near **$1.75 trillion**.

- **June 12, 2026** — SPCX began trading on the Nasdaq and closed its first day around **$161**, up roughly 19% from the IPO price.
